Azure/aaz.name: aaz
Azure/aaz.readme_excerpt: This repository is used to perserve the atomic Azure CLI command models created by aaz-dev-tools. For API version `2026-09-01-preview`, `afd profile create` deliberately supplements the Swagger contract with the optional `--environment-type NonProduction` input at `properties.extendedProperties.environmentType`. Swagger marks the containing `extendedProperties` dictionary read-only, but the RP accepts this specific value when creating an AFD profile in a preview-enabled subscription. Preserve this AAZ-only override when re-importing Swagger or regenerating commands. Do not expose the dictionary as an arbitrary writable argument, add this input to update commands, or apply it to Classic CDN. Response models remain read-only.

Azure/RSL.name: RSL
Azure/RSL.description: Replicated State Library. RSL is the Azure Paxos implementation which is used by multiple products in Azure and Bing. It provides the traditional Paxos functionality in a real world implementation. RSL includes support for dynamic replica set reconfiguration, including dynamic growth/srinking of the cluster, and also service-healing (replica replacement). RSL automates the durability of the state (by means of both durable journal files, and periodic snapshots). RSL allows multi-rings per process, allowing a single process to be part of multiple rings at the same time. RSL is implemented in C/C++ and provides a C# wrapper that naturally integrates with C# applications. RSL is widely used in Azure for a large number of infrastructure components, ranging from Azure Fabric Controller, to Azure Storage.

Azure Disk Encryption (ADE) is a capability that helps you encrypt your Windows and Linux IaaS virtual machine disks. ADE leverages the industry standard BitLocker feature of Windows and the DM-Crypt feature of Linux to provide volume encryption for the OS and data disks. The solution is integrated with Azure Key Vault to help you control and manage the disk-encryption keys and secrets. The solution also ensures that all data on the virtual machine disks are encrypted at rest in your Azure storage.
